x: Tony Fairclough was ranked 7th in the Juniors behind Yates, Hammond, Edwards (Scot), McCafferty (Scot), Walker and Watters. For some reason the Youths' rankings were only taken down to six, but John Bicourt can feel confident he would have been placed 8th.
It was obvious then, as it is now, that the three hot favourites for representation in the 5,000 metres at Mexico were McCafferty, Taylor and Rushmer.

This was the occasion when everyone expected the 'terrible three' - Rushmer, Taylor and McCafferty - to clinch their Olympic places. But the latter did not appear and does not seem to be interested in Mexico.
